levels.notes: Yellow House 51 top-floor arrangement follows the resident annotation of 15 November 2026; EG and 1. OG remain exactly as previously drawn and await separate instructions. The twenty-one single apartments are the nineteen existing top-floor modules plus E at the left of the A wing and N0 at the right of the N wing. The W wing retains W4, W3 and W2 only. The independent floor outline is the union of whole 3.10 m modules, 1.40 m hallways and the accepted 2.70 x 7.40 m stair block. The blue-marked extensions and other residual source-shell gaps are removed from this floor only. Clear single interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m with two 0.20 m side allocations. The room width is resident measured; room length, wall allocations, hall width and stair split remain the accepted modeling assumptions. The lime marks determine which end of each room-to-hall wall receives its door. Doorways are drawn 0.90 m wide with their centre 0.60 m from the indicated clear-room edge, leaving a schematic 0.15 m jamb. These offsets are not new measurements. Both E labels are retained as drawn: the added E in the A wing and the existing E in the East wing have separate identifiers and descriptive selection labels. The existing rigid Yellow registration and its retained 0.40 m core offset keep the stair block aligned with the untouched lower floors. Room dimensions are neither fitted nor scaled to the folded exterior. Layout window symbols, door offsets, stair treads and room internals remain schematic. The folded Yellow exterior and all original facade window evidence are preserved separately.

levels.notes: House 55 / EG repeats the completed 1. OG apartment layout at the same campus position, including sixteen single apartments and four shared-apartment envelopes. The three blue-marked areas removed from 1. OG are retained on EG: two 9.30 x 4.50 m outer strips and the 2.70 x 2.90 m stair-side spur. The eastern common strip and its restored outer area form the cinema beside R. The western equivalents form the laundry beside L, as confirmed by the resident. Single apartments retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors and 3.10 m modules. Shared apartments A, W1, N3-N4 and G-H retain their 6.20 x 7.40 m gross envelopes, including the perpendicular hall allowance. The 1.40 m hall runs and 2.70 m stair enclosure keep the exact first-floor geometry. The confirmed 8.10 m W return is retained. levels.label: 1. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident first-floor annotations and the accepted 2. OG module plan, 15 November 2026; sixteen 2.70 x 6.00 m singles, four 6.20 x 7.40 m assumed shared envelopes, two enclosed balconies and 1.40 m halls.
levels.notes: House 55 / 1. OG uses the accepted 2. OG module plan at the same campus position, with the resident first-floor additions and cutouts from 15 November 2026. Sixteen single apartments retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors and two 0.20 m side strips, giving a 3.10 m module. Shared apartments W1, A, N3-N4 and G-H each combine two 3.10 m module widths with the perpendicular 6.00 m room plus 1.40 m hallway depth: a 6.20 x 7.40 m assumed gross envelope. The joined pairs have one entrance and no intervening room or hallway divider. Their internal partitions and net areas are not established. Both 9.30 x 2.90 m strips are separate balcony enclosures, each reached through one door near the stair end of its hallway-facing wall. The blue 4.50 m deep portions and the earlier stair-side spur remain outside this floor outline. The W wing is 15.50 m long. The resident confirmed an 8.10 m inner return instead of the annotated 5.00 m, preserving the 7.40 m top-floor core and all other final dimensions. Hallways are 1.40 m wide. The unchanged stair block has the requested 1.30 m flight column plus 1.40 m walkway. Door and window symbols and stair treads remain illustrative.

levels.notes: Resident confirmation for White House 57, 15 November 2026: use the completed Red House 55 interior arrangement and replace White’s previous provisional floor outlines. The twenty single apartments, room banks, hallways, stairs, side-wall allocations and complete floor outline match the accepted Red House 55 top floor exactly in local metres. There are no top-floor layout differences from Red. The same rigid House 57 registration is used on all three floors, with no rescaling, bank shifts, shortened rooms or omitted apartments. The 2.70 m stair enclosure, 1.30 m flight column and 1.40 m walkway align vertically. Single clear interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m with two 0.20 m side allocations, giving 3.10 m modules; halls remain 1.40 m wide. Shared envelopes remain 6.20 x 7.40 m gross. The resident confirmed the matching arrangement and named differences. These are independent modeling assumptions, not a survey of White: exact openings, floor elevations, bathroom and kitchen partitions, shared-apartment internals and service-space fittings remain unresolved. Door, window and stair symbols are schematic. White’s original folded exterior and any source window evidence remain separate and unchanged.

levels.source: Resident-confirmed Green House 59 arrangement, 15 November 2026. The complete 2. OG matches Red House 55 in local geometry, including its rooms, halls, stairs and any balconies.
levels.notes: Resident confirmation for Green House 59, 15 November 2026: the top floor and 1. OG match completed Red House 55 exactly; EG follows the supplied Hausmeister, Garden room, Storage and extra-dorm annotation. All twenty single apartments, halls, stairs, side-wall allocations and the independent outline match the Red top floor exactly in local metres. A single rigid House 59 registration anchors all three floors; no scaling, bank shifts, room clipping or shortened modules remain. The stair enclosure, flight and walkway align vertically. Singles retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors, two 0.20 m side allocations and 3.10 m modules. Halls remain 1.40 m wide; shared envelopes remain 6.20 x 7.40 m gross. The resident confirmed the arrangement. Exact openings, floor heights, kitchen and bathroom partitions, shared-apartment internals and common-area fittings remain schematic or unresolved; the red H marks the Hausmeister area and does not establish internal partitions. Green’s folded official exterior and source window evidence remain separate and unchanged. Schematic layout openings do not transfer Red’s measured facade observations.
